attributes.name: doSort
attributes.description: Used, when new body is added to the scene.

attributes.name: isPeriodic
attributes.description: Whether periodic boundary conditions are active.

attributes.name: selectedBody
attributes.description: Id of body that is selected by the user

attributes.name: stopAtIter
attributes.description: Iteration after which to stop the simulation.

attributes.name: stopAtTime
attributes.description: Time after which to stop the simulation

attributes.name: subStep
attributes.description: Number of sub-step; not to be changed directly. -1 means to run loop prologue (cell integration), 0…n-1 runs respective engines (n is number of engines), n runs epilogue (increment step number and time.

attributes.name: subStepping
attributes.description: Whether we currently advance by one engine in every step (rather than by single run through all engines).

attributes.name: subdomain
attributes.description: the subdomain this scene is assigned in MPI/domain decomposition.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Arbitrary key=value associations (tags like mp3 tags: author, date, version, description etc.)
